latestIgtvVideos.title: Phone Home Screen Organization
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
📲 You all know that I am obsessed with digital organization… So when the new iOS 14 came out I had to jump on the bandwagon and update my phone… But I DIDN’T go all out.⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
I have a system that works great for me, it reduces the amount of time that I’m on my phone, it makes me more efficient, and it calms me… Why change that? 🤷‍♀️⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
Updates are great. Systems that don’t work should definitely be updated. But systems that do work can be left alone.⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
I’ve seen hundreds of people saying they spent hours updating their phone, and hated it and changed it back. 🤦🏼‍♀️ I’ve definitely done this my fair share of times also… But now I’m confident in the systems that I put in place.⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
If a system is working for you and your family, don’t feel the pressure to change it. Feel the pressure to change the systems that are NOT working! 😌⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
Did you do the update? How are you liking it 👇⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
 ⠀
❤️ Always, Jess.⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
 ⠀

latestIgtvVideos.title: Why Do I Climb Into a Freezer with 35 Degree Water?
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
🥶
 
.
Definitely NOT because it’s fun 😂 it’s a challenge- both mentally and physically- and pushes me to be better. If you challenge yourself to do hard things, you grow. Have difficult conversations, tackle hard projects, push in your workouts, and push your body in every way possible to be BETTER. It’s not easy, some days I can’t bring myself to climb in, but I’ve never climbed out wishing I didn’t.⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
Ice baths push me mentally in a way I never thought possible- how calm can you keep your body in ICE COLD water? But besides the challenge, ice baths also push me to focus on my breathing, allow me to connect with my body, help my muscles recover, increases endorphins, reduce stress levels, increase alertness, increases immune response, and builds on my willpower.⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
It took me years to come around to the idea, but now I try to take one almost everyday. In addition to ice baths; we also sauna, roll out, stretch, floss, scrape, cup, and use a percussive therapy device. Recovery is so important in the Haizman household!⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
What’s the hardest thing you have ever done? Hardest hike? Race? All nighter? Yoga class? 👇 Comment and brag all about your accomplishments- I want to hear!⠀
 ⠀
.⠀
❤️ Always, Jess.⠀
 ⠀
.⠀

My 4-year-old still rear faces in her car seat. And she will until she outgrows it (meaning hits the weight or height limit). 

Most people don’t realize that rear facing is actually the safest position for kids for as long as their seat allows, because their neck and spine are still developing.

Forward facing too early puts a lot more force on their neck during a crash.

Every family makes their own choices, but for us this one felt like an easy decision.

Curious what everyone else does —
when did your kids turn forward facing?

#rearfacing #momlife #momsofinstagram #relatablemom #crunchymama

Winter boots for kids can be SO clunky!! This is not the best option for healthy foot development.

There are a few things I always look for before I buy. ❄️🥾

I want my kids’ boots to keep their feet warm and dry without squeezing their toes or restricting the way their feet naturally move. 

I look for a wide toe box, flexible sole, lightweight design, and enough room for those little toes to spread and move.

Because warm feet are important… but healthy, happy feet matter too. 🤍

I’ve done the research (and the trial and error 😅) so you don’t have to!

💬 Comment BOOTS and I’ll send you my Amazon list of my favorite barefoot-friendly winter boot options for kids!

#BarefootKids #KidsWinterBoots #WinterBoots #HealthyFeet #̭parentingtips

Months ago, my 2-year-old failed the little eye screening at his pediatrician’s office.

He didn’t squint. He didn’t complain. He didn’t act like he couldn’t see. We genuinely had no idea anything was wrong.

After a full dilated eye exam, we found out he is significantly nearsighted — with a prescription around what mine was as an adult. 🤯

And I think the part I keep coming back to is… if his pediatrician hadn’t done that screening, how long would it have taken us to realize?

I also had NO idea how they could possibly get an accurate eye exam on a nervous 2-year-old who can’t sit there reading letters off a chart 😂 but the whole process was honestly fascinating.

Now we’re onto the next chapter: glasses, finding frames that actually stay on a toddler, specialty lenses + figuring out what insurance will cover. 👓

Follow along because I’ll share everything I’m learning as we figure this out. 🤍

So… we’re starting the minivan search before I’m pregnant because I already know pregnant me will NOT want to deal with car shopping 😅

Minivan parents, I need your help: what do you drive, what do you love/hate about it, and would you buy it again? 👇

One of my absolute FAVORITE activities in our house: our sensory swing! 🤍

If you have kids who love to move, climb, spin, or just need a cozy place to decompress, a sensory swing is seriously amazing.

✨ Helps with sensory input and regulation
✨ Provides vestibular movement (spinning/swaying)
✨ Can help kids calm their bodies and focus
✨ Encourages balance, coordination & body awareness
✨ Gives kids a safe way to get energy out
✨ Creates a cozy little spot for reading, relaxing, or quiet time

It might be a little early but I think it makes an AMAZING Christmas gift! 🎄 

Especially because once winter hits and everyone is cooped up inside, having something your kids can use to MOVE and get their energy out is a total game changer.

We use ours ALL the time!

🔗 Comment SWING and I’ll send you the link!

I really wish someone had told me this before we started swim lessons. 😅

I never thought much about the chlorine beyond making sure my kids showered after swimming… but when they started swimming regularly, I realized just how much chlorine exposure was adding up.

And indoor pools?! That strong chlorine smell hits DIFFERENT. 😂

That’s why Chlorine Cleanse has become a staple in our swim bag. It’s an after-swim spray that helps neutralize chlorine residue on skin and hair before we rinse off.

And just because summer is ending doesn’t mean swim season is! Between swim lessons, indoor water parks, and year-round swimming, this is one of those things I’m glad to have on hand all year.
